name: RefreshButton
purpose: Icon-only convenience action for the familiar Refresh utility.

guidance.useWhen: Use when an icon-only Refresh action is conventional and the default Refresh label accurately describes the action.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for labelled business actions or when Refresh does not precisely describe the result.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Use only for the familiar Refresh utility action; prefer Button or IconButton for other actions.

accessibility: Defaults aria-label and tooltip to "Refresh"; callers may override aria-label when the context requires a more specific accessible name.
knownLimitations: Avoid as a substitute for labelled business actions; use only for the matching familiar utility action.
